# Step - age

`age` · category: [Dates and times](../../traversal/step_reference.md#dates-and-times)

The difference as a duration (PostgreSQL age).

## Forms

```text
age(arg1: any)
age(arg1: any, arg2: string)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject(date("2001-04-10")).age(date("1957-06-13")).next().months   // 525
```
